answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 148007 Country: Maharashtra Title: Issues of urine drops Question: I have a problem of urine leakage only when it gets stored and not passed the urine after some times when I go to washroom I see in my underwear there are 1 or 2 drops; and sometimes also I see drops over my underwear. Sometimes I cannot figure out whether it is urine or madhi. So please tell me how to clean these things over my underwear. Should I remove and then clean? If yes, and I am outside home and use toilets in masjid or office so how should I clean. Answer ID: 148007 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 272/261/SD=4/1438) First make it sure that you don’t stop the urine pressure for a long time and should do it immediately after you feel it, so that it does not drop. However, if sometimes the drops come, wash them. If the drop of urine or madhi spreads more than the depth of palm, then salah shall not be valid without cleaning it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
